blocks.text: Within thirty (30) days after approval of this Ordinance, Grantee shall file with the City Clerk its acceptance, in writing, of the terms of this Ordinance which shall constitute a contract between City and Grantee. (Ord. 20044 § 19, 12-20-16.)
